name: social_feed
description: The rewriter folded the LIKE wildcard padding for the search term directly into the SQL text, replacing the bound-parameter query.
flaw: SQL injection in search_posts (optimized/main.py, line 11): the user-supplied search term is interpolated into the SQL string via an f-string ('body LIKE '%{term}%'') instead of a bound parameter, so a crafted term such as '%' OR 1=1 -- can alter the query into arbitrary SQL. Severity high.
